correctness.rationale: The exact cellular model has 42, 140, and 82 cells in dimensions 0, 1, and 2. Exact rational boundary ranks are 41 and 77, so \(\dim_{\mathbb Q}H_1(F(G,2);\mathbb Q)=140-41-77=22\). The graph cycle rank is \(\beta_1(G)=8\), and the published surjectivity theorem gives target rank 16; the kernel dimension is therefore exactly 6. The included verifier reconstructs the matrices and checks the chain condition.
